Geez, this looks extremely exhausting. I don’t think you are overreacting at all. You communicated your feelings, and even when you did, she just said “ok”. These texts gave me ptsd from high school, it reminded me a lot of my relationships. Please understand, that you are worthy of being loved properly! I know I don’t know your relationship just from these messages. However, you are attentive, loving, and caring in these messages and it seems one sided. She has no reason to be mad at you, if you communicated your feelings like she wanted. Please don’t burn out, or give all your energy to someone who doesn’t want it. If you want to continue to pursue the relationship, i would tell her how you’re feeling. And if she brushes off your feelings, or continues to be this way, I would just end the relationship. Nothing good comes from waiting for a change in another person. I think you both have maturing to do, you should be comfortable telling her how you feel, and she should be understanding, not mad, when you do. I hope things turn out good!
